items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: January of 1945 is when Fats Navarro joins us, and we started our trek South.

ctx.x: So that was on New Year's Eve of 1944.

January of 1945 is when Fats Navarro joins us, and we started our trek South. We played again the Royal Theatre in Baltimore, the Howard Theatre in Washington, D.C., and then we went points South, not missing a state. We played a couple of places in Virginia, Richmond I think, and somewhere else. Then we went to North South Carolina and played two or three places there, then South Carolina, Georgia. Of course, we played Jacksonville, Florida, and Miami and Tampa. As a matter of fact, we had a very long…

We stayed in Texas I guess about a week, playing different places, because Texas is so big, and there are so many towns there that you can play. Houston, Dallas, San Anton, Fort Worth, and two or three other places. Anyway, it was always good to be down there, because we were very well received.
